mapper.select: SELECT program_id AS programId, program_nm AS programNm, url_path AS urlPath, program_type AS programType, use_yn AS useYn FROM PROGRAMS ORDER BY program_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROGRAMS (program_nm, url_path, program_type, use_yn, ins_id, ins_ip) VALUES (#{programNm}, #{urlPath}, #{programType}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{insId}, #{insIp})
mapper.select: SELECT role_id AS roleId, program_id AS programId FROM ROLE_PROGRAMS ORDER BY program_id, role_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROLE_PROGRAMS (role_id, program_id, ins_id, ins_ip) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{programId}, #{insId}, #{insIp})
